✨ ghostty-config | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Generating and customizing configuration files for the Ghostty terminal through a user-friendly web interface.
✨ Key Features: • Interactive settings editor for fonts, colors, cursor styles, transparency, blur, etc. • Rich, purpose-built input controls for various setting types • Repeatable settings management with a dedicated list editor • Hundreds of built-in Ghostty color themes
📖 Summary: Ghostty Config is a web-based tool that simplifies the customization of the Ghostty terminal. It provides an intuitive interface to visually adjust settings, preview changes in real-time, and export a clean, ready-to-use configuration file.
